set.body:
Turn the ablation decision into one small maintained engine and update the parent P7 evidence.

Acceptance gate:
- Select the default from G5 evidence and preserve a reproducible reference lane until cleanup is complete. Remove or demote losing default machinery rather than carrying two accidental architectures.
- If one-way CC wins, first re-audit derivative, half-step scale, and interpolation parity; open a separately gated dual-anchored symmetric objective only if the result persists.
- If 8/12 mm synthetic capture fails while 2/4 mm passes, open the smallest reusable coarse block/stencil proposal experiment. FFT, learned features, and signed-distance assistance remain disabled until that gate exists.
- Profile before optimizing. Optimize only the selected native pull, box sums, gradients, rank-one pointwise step, Gaussian geometry, map composition, and Jacobian/export reductions.
- Image receives only general destination-writing kernels. Gale changes require a measured general deficiency, a reusable API, a standalone benchmark, and evidence from at least one non-registration consumer or a clear core-linalg contract.
- Run compileAll and testAll, with all affected shared suites passing on JVM and Scala.js and warning-clean.
- Publish selected-lane receipts for accuracy, runtime, allocations, peak memory, topology, inverse export, support, and code/API footprint. Do not claim ANTs parity without the expanded paired cohort and an explicit statistical criterion.
- Update P7 with the selected profile and remaining gap. Close this epic only when the evidence supports selection/rejection and all admitted-result contracts are satisfied.
set.title: HalfFlow-CC G6: architecture selection, cleanup, and profile-led speed
